column1: # Trimmed descriptions for adopted skills whose upstream description is over 300 characters.
# One line per skill: name<TAB>description. Applied by bin/install-skill-packs.sh after the copy.
# Prime puts every description in the system prompt on every turn, so short ones keep the
# budget under about 4,000 tokens (docs/briefs/skill-packs.md). Keep the upstream trigger words.

column2: Create or update the product marketing context document (positioning, target audience, ICP) that the other marketing skills read. Use at the start of a marketing project, or when the user says 'product context', 'positioning', 'who is my target audience' or 'ideal customer profile'.

Audit, review or diagnose SEO issues on a site. Use for 'SEO audit', 'technical SEO', 'why am I not ranking', 'traffic dropped', 'core web vitals', 'crawl errors', 'indexing issues', or a vague 'help with SEO': start with an audit. Structured data: see seo-schema. AI search: see seo-geo.

Plan a product launch, feature announcement or release strategy. Use for 'launch', 'Product Hunt', 'feature release', 'go-to-market', 'beta launch', 'early access', 'waitlist', 'launch checklist', 'GTM plan' or 'we're about to ship'. Press coverage: see public-relations.

Create or optimize an email sequence, drip campaign, automated flow or lifecycle program. Use for 'email sequence', 'nurture sequence', 'onboarding emails', 'welcome series', 're-engagement emails', 'email automation' or 'what emails should I send'. Any multi-email automated flow.

Plan a content strategy: what to write about, topic clusters, content pillars, editorial calendar, content roadmap. Use for 'content strategy', 'content ideas', 'blog strategy', 'content planning' or 'I don't know what to write'. One piece: see copywriting. SEO audits: see seo-audit.

Set up, improve or audit analytics tracking and measurement. Use for 'set up tracking', 'GA4', 'conversion tracking', 'event tracking', 'UTM parameters', 'tag manager', 'tracking plan', 'Mixpanel', 'Segment', 'are my events firing', or any 'how do I measure this'.

Public relations, earned media, press coverage, journalist outreach and media strategy (not pull requests). Use for 'PR', 'press release', 'media outreach', 'pitch a journalist', 'media list', 'press kit', 'newsjacking', 'HARO', 'op-ed', 'podcast prep' or 'how do I get press'. Launches: see launch.

Write, rewrite or improve marketing copy for any page: homepage, landing, pricing, feature, about or product pages. Use for 'write copy for', 'improve this copy', 'headline help', 'CTA copy', 'value proposition', 'tagline', 'hero section', 'this copy is weak' or 'make this more compelling'.

Find the papers that answer a research query in Firecrawl's paper index (PubMed, bioRxiv, medRxiv, arXiv) with semantic search, expansion and in-body verification. Use for literature-finding and paper-retrieval tasks, one paper or a full set. Reached only through the firecrawl research tools.

Produce an intensive, cited analytical report from the open web: executive summary, multi-angle findings, contrarian views, open questions, full sources. Use only for rigorous synthesis of a complex topic that needs a formal report. Not for quick lookups, top-N lists or paper reviews.

Conduct systematic literature reviews across academic databases (PubMed, arXiv, bioRxiv, Semantic Scholar). Use for systematic reviews, meta-analyses, research synthesis or comprehensive literature searches in science and technology. Produces formatted markdown and PDF with verified citations.

Search 18 scholarly APIs (PubMed, PMC, Europe PMC, bioRxiv, medRxiv, arXiv, OpenAlex, Crossref, Semantic Scholar, CORE, Unpaywall, OpenCitations, Zenodo, ROR, DOAJ) with reproducible provenance. Use for 'find papers on X', DOI or PMID lookups, citation graphs, open-access PDFs, author publications.

Audit and fix agent readiness: Lighthouse Agentic Browsing fraction, accessibility tree for agents, robots.txt and Content-Signal, WAF treatment of agent traffic, llms.txt, Markdown delivery, ai-catalog.json, /.well-known files and WebMCP tools. AI citability and brand signals: see seo-geo.
